question: The novel 'The White Tiger' was written by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravind Adiga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Aravind Adiga is an Indian author and journalist from Madras.
 
• The novel, published in **2008**, won the **Man Booker Prize** the same year.
 
• It explores issues of class struggle, poverty, and corruption in India through the eyes of its protagonis
